stage_a_inputs.focus: Morty confronts his fears inside the Fear Hole, a mysterious pit located inside a Denny's restroom that forces anyone who jumps into it to face their deepest psychological fears. Morty undergoes various intense, surreal manifestations of fear—including emotional and psychological realizations about his dependence on Rick and his fear of rejection—as he tries to overcome the hole's illusions to escape back to reality.
